what_this_is: The demo conversation at the tool level, with no model involved: the script chose each tool call. It shows the server half works end to end against live data.

pothole.say: There's a big pothole in front of 617 E Third St.

streetlight.say: The streetlight outside 4 Jersey Street is out.

trash.say: When does trash go out at 700 Boylston Street?

steps.step: Pothole report finds an existing report

arguments.description: There's a big pothole in front of the building.

steps.spoken_summary: Someone already reported a pothole at 617 E Third St yesterday, at the same spot, and it is still open. Do you want to follow that report instead of filing a new one?
You are now following the pothole report at 617 E Third St, which is open. Ask me about your requests any time to hear what has changed.

steps.step: Streetlight report needs one answer first

arguments.description: There is a problem with the streetlight.

steps.spoken_summary: Is the light completely out, flickering, or on during the day?

steps.step: With the answer, the report is filed in the sandbox

arguments.description: There is a problem with the streetlight.

steps.spoken_summary: Done. I filed your streetlight outage report for 4 Jersey St in the CityDesk sandbox, reference SB-94019. It is a test system, so nothing was sent to the city, and I will remember it when you ask about your requests.

steps.step: Status check in a new session
steps.spoken_summary: You have 2 requests, and one has changed since you last checked. Your street light outage report at 4 Jersey St has an update. The latest note says: Assigned to a Street Lighting crew. (Simulated by the CityDesk sandbox.) The pothole report at 617 E Third St is still open.

steps.step: Duplicate check with a cold cache (fresh download from Boston)
steps.spoken_summary: There is 1 open pothole report near 617 E Third St. The nearest at 617 E Third St was reported yesterday, at the same spot.
At 700 Boylston St, trash and recycling are both picked up on Mondays and Thursdays. The next pickup is this Thursday, October 15th.

checks.sandbox_note_after_wait: Assigned to a Street Lighting crew. (Simulated by the CityDesk sandbox.)

tool_latency_ms.note: Calls that reach Boston take a few hundred milliseconds; a duplicate check right after the place finder ran reuses a cached list; the cold-cache step shows the uncached cost.
